subject: Confirmation of Hotel Reservation
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your reservation at City View Hotel for your upcoming trip to New York City. Your booking is for a deluxe room from [Check-In Date] to [Check-Out Date]. Please review the attached itinerary for further details. We look forward to welcoming you and hope you have a pleasant stay with us. If you have any questions or need to make changes to your reservation, feel free to contact our customer service team. Warm regards, City View Hotel
